_comment: Sizes distillation students built from the catalog to one training and one sampling GPU with batch 1, and sets mb_spec packing, ZeRO reduce_scatter and the huggingface model provider. Skipped with job_config=. With job_id=, the merged job is not submitted, but the example still reads settings such as the model, batch size and learning rate from it, so keep them matching the attached job. See recipes/README.md, "How an example builds its job", for how this file is merged.
